description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2540014608048 COVER, SEAT, VEHICULAR: Line 0001 Qty 257 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0129 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
